records.title: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
records.application_period: Applications for the 2027 intake must be filed within the first Master's application window: 15 December for IS-Academia applicants and 31 January for EPFL students applying for a consecutive Master's degree.

records.title: MIT Undergraduate Need-Based Financial Aid and MIT Scholarship for International Students
records.deadline_display: To apply for financial aid, all students must submit the CSS Profile and parental tax returns or income documentation through IDOC by the following deadlines: Early Action November 30, Regular Action February 15, Transfer February 15. MIT publishes no calendar year for these dates.
records.application_period: Annual cycle. Early Action November 30, Regular Action February 15, Transfer February 15; aid documents manageable through the MIT Application Portal until mid-May.
